blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) has ordered its Registry to modify the template for external requests for authorization and submissions related to the “situation” — referring to the court’s overall investigation in a country over a specific period — which focuses on alleged killings linked to the drug war under former President Rodrigo Duterte. In an order dated Nov. 23 (Tuesday, Nov. 24, in Manila), Presiding Judge Iulia Antoanella Motoc, with the concurrence of judges Reine Adélaïde Sophie Alapini-Gansou and María del Socorro Flores Liera, issued the directive “to ensure their efficient and effective processing.” READ: Camp of […]...
